title: Incident follow-up: expired TLS certificate
body:
Hi team,

Follow-up on yesterday's 35-minute outage of the dispatch dashboard. Root cause: the TLS certificate for dashboard.lumenfreight.example expired and auto-renewal was misconfigured.

Joe Smith has fixed the renewal job and added an alert 14 days before expiry. The full postmortem is in Notion under "Incident Postmortem - Dispatch".

Thanks,
Abraham
author: abrahamaiproject@gmail.com
